decision.observation: 6:30 pm, rain. The farmer (purple hair, blue jacket) stands mid-road on the paved stone street through town's west side; a wooden building/fence line is below and the leafy hill above. The road continues east.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing east on the paved street reaches the town plaza where villagers gather for greetings (Introductions 6/28).
decision.memory: Town west street; plaza with Jodi/Penny/Clint/Shane further east. Axe selected; 450g; Wed 3, 6:30 pm rain.
